multi-million dollar national remodeling companies and their sales teams,
before founding a marketing agency. Sales is his stated primary specialty.

## Build method
Hand-coded HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No WordPress, no page builders, no themes.
Schema-first architecture, spam-hardened lead capture, bilingual where required.

## Pricing
Custom websites start at $99 per month, structured as a lease with a buyout
option at 24 to 36 months based on the site's valuation at that time. Sites can
also be bought outright. SEO, AI optimization and fractional CMO engagements are
quoted to the client's budget, company and goals rather than sold at a fixed rate.

## What he will not claim
He does not guarantee rankings, traffic or revenue, and states plainly that no
honest provider can. What he commits to instead: putting the client's business
first, working on it as if it were his own company, giving the client the
technology and marketing skill he has, and genuinely trying to grow the company.
